learning_outcomes.text: Students can infer the properties of an element based on its position in the periodic table, write reaction equations for simple chemical reactions, and perform simple stoichiometric calculations.
Students have sound basic chemical knowledge as a prerequisite for a deeper understanding of the structure and properties of materials.
Students can record observations of chemical experiments and discuss them in a group.

syllabus_topics: Practicum: Learning how to handle chemicals, performing basic operations in the chemistry lab
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam, details as per the valid study regulations. The ungraded assessment is experimental work, approximately 3 days of experiments.
bibliography: Pfestorf, R., H. Kadner, Chemie: Ein Lehrbuch für Fachhochschulen, Verlag Harri Deutsch, Frankfurt, 9. Auflage, 2013
C. E. Mortimer, Chemie. Das Basiswissen der Chemie, Georg Thieme Verlag Stuttgart, New York, 13. Auflage, 2019
